source.notes: Copied byte-for-byte to source.png. The source contains a gray background and visible row captions in the original reference.

derivative.generatedNotes: The targeted imagegen edit preserved the visible pose order and robot silhouettes but returned a baked checkerboard instead of alpha. It was not used directly as the app atlas.

alphaStep.rule: Pixels with near-neutral RGB and minimum channel >= 205 were flood-filled from the image edge using 8-neighbor connectivity; visited pixels received alpha 0 and robot pixels were retained.

frameExtraction.method: alpha projection with measured connected horizontal and vertical gaps; 16px horizontal and 8px vertical transparent padding around each visible robot

unusedSourceSequence.reason: Combat is outside the recorded colony replay and the P02 contract.

building.notes: New near-frontal workshop scale reference; not a recovered simulation construction.

limitations: Only one supplied character design exists; Explorer and Builder share this art and are distinguished in UI markers.
The sheet has front/side approximations but no complete back or eight-direction set.
Alpha extraction is mechanical because the image tool returned RGB; visual acceptance remains T01/G01.
